title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 9: What Remains

planning.storytellingVoice: Intimate character drama: accountability and grief turn into a shared practical commitment.
planning.sourceBoundary: Resolve Ren’s account and eastern watch, identify Min’s temporary western bypass, establish finite surface cistern and empty deep reserve, close unsafe bypass, converge on rebuilding the town supply.
planning.dramaticChange: Jonathan stops treating every problem as something he can decide for others; he asks people to own their actions and helps them undertake one common repair.
planning.earlyCare: Ren waits outside rather than intruding on the mother and child.
planning.desire: Finish the promises already made and learn where the unexplained water comes from.
planning.obstacle: Apology does not earn forgiveness; Min’s useful cooling water is not drinking water and the failing bypass cannot safely continue.
planning.englishNarrationPurpose: Optional help and context only; narrative stays Mandarin.
choicesAndCallbacks: Opening: speak plainly or give Mother room; different reply, same truthful account.
Mother: offer practical help or ask what she wants; no forced forgiveness.
Min: ask about water or his secrecy; distinct motive reply, same explanation.
Inspection: follow inlet or inspect outlet; different observation, both physically trace the same closed cooling circuit and finite tank.
Closure: turn control with Min or ask him to close it; same safe shutdown and shared morning repair, different accountability exchange.
sceneActivities: Ren waits for permission; Mother sits during the reader-controlled aftermath using supported seated rest.
Jonathan and An approach by level path; An never climbs, lifts or operates a heavy control.
Jonathan crouches to inspect the pipe; Min guides inspection and operates the stop lever.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Plain questions become invitations to act together; stops and listens after Mother refuses easy closure.
actingSignature.Mother: Specific boundaries and requests; guarded stillness softens toward work, never automatic forgiveness.
actingSignature.Ren: Owns actions in short first-person statements; waits for permission and respects refusal.
actingSignature.An: Precise practical limits, independent voice; stays on safe ground.
actingSignature.Min: Protective, defensive explanations; names grief or worry without using it as an excuse.

planning.listenerTurn: Jonathan/Ren pair → Mother says she can hear without forgiving → Ren listener shot and short answer → shared frame. Jonathan/Min pair → Mei alive/dead memory → Jonathan listener holds a reader-controlled response → shared inspection.
planning.payoff: Mother hears Ren; current eastern calls/watch arrangements explicitly settled without changing old key ownership. Min admits opening a temporary cooling bypass; flow comes from finite surface tank, not a secret deep reserve. Deep well gauge and inspection show empty. Everyone agrees to shut failing bypass and work on the town supply at dawn.
planning.freshQuestion: No unresolved mystery from this arc. Next episode begins the common practical work of rebuilding a safe supply; past choices remain memory and consequences, not separate plot trunks.
